title: Pimpinela Unveils Leyendas U.S. Tour Dates: ‘It’s An Expression of Gratitude’
summary: Leyendas Tour comes on the heels of the Argentine duo’s Noticias de Amor Tour across Latin America and Europe.
contentText:
Pimpinela is hitting the road with its 2026 Leyendas U.S. Tour, Billboard can exclusively announce on Thursday (July 16).

Presented by Arpi Live, the intimate five-date trek will kick off Nov. 13 at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles and wrap at Miami’s James L. Knight Center on Nov. 22. In between, the Argentine duo—composed of siblings Lucía and Joaquín Galán—will perform in Chicago, Boston, and New York. 

“This show is not only a tribute to our songs but also an expression of gratitude to the audience that has stood by us all these years,” Joaquín said in a press statement. “They are the ones who made this story possible, and we want to celebrate it together.”

For the past 45 years, the talented pair has become one of the bestselling Latin music artists thanks to its potent and often theatrical ballads powered by heartfelt and passionate lyrics. Pimpinela is known for timeless hits such as “Olvídame y Pega la Vuelta,” “Con Un Nudo En La Garganta,” “A Esa” and “Por Ese Hombre.”

The former of the four tracks received a salsa-infused treatment by Jennifer Lopez and Marc Anthony, who performed it together at the 2016 Latin Grammys, and last year, the latter track was covered by Miranda! and Abraham Mateo, further demonstrating Pimpinela’s influence in today’s generation.  

“Every artist has a story that deserves to be told with excellence,” noted Claudio Resnick, CEO of Arpi Live. “Our commitment is to attend to every detail to create an unforgettable experience for the audience and deliver value to our strategic partners.”

Leyendas Tour—which comes on the heels of the duo’s Noticias de Amor Tour across Latin America and Europe—will promise a visually stunning staging concept that combines live musicians, choirs, dancers and original audiovisual content, as well as guests such as Dyango.

Tickets will go on presale on Aug. 4 and for the general public on Aug. 6. The link will be revealed soon on Pimpinela’s social pages. See the full tour dates below.

- Nov. 13 — Los Angeles @ Dolby Theatre

- Nov. 15 — Chicago @ Rosemont Theatre

- Nov. 17 — Boston @ Lynn Memorial Auditorium

- Nov. 18 — New York @ United Palace

- Nov. 22 — Miami @ James L. Knight Center
